rubric.role_summary: Fixed-term field sales and training role covering five Sephora stores in London. Responsible for retail sell-out, training Beauty Advisor teams, store relationships, and in-store brand presentation.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Fixed-term field sales and training role covering five Sephora stores in London. Responsible for retail sell-out, training Beauty Advisor teams, store relationships, and in-store brand presentation.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- Either 2+ years in prestige cosmetic sales and education, or experience as a senior Beauty Advisor ready to advance.
- Experience delivering product training or demonstrations in a retail beauty setting.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Sephora experience.
- K-Beauty knowledge.
- A track record of driving sell-out in a retail environment.
- Experience delivering training, in-store events, and product demonstrations to a floor team.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Location: Greater London, United Kingdom area. Onsite work is based in this area, and candidates must currently be located in it. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them.
